terra.problem: The card combines three distinct places: Rehoboth-Ir in Assyria, Isaac’s well named Rehoboth, and Rehoboth on the Euphrates. The moments therefore do not all happen at the same Rehoboth. Separate the places or make the card explicitly about places sharing the name.
The line’s phrase “the lists of Assyria and Edom’s kings” is confusing: Rehoboth-Ir is named in a list of cities, while Rehoboth on the Euphrates identifies where the Edomite king Shaul was from.
Shaul was from Rehoboth on the Euphrates, but Genesis 36:36–38 does not say that he became king or reigned there.
